title: Centre extends Afspa in parts of Manipur, Arunachal, Nagaland for 6 more months
content: the centre has extended the Armed Forces (Special Powers) Act (Afspa) for another six months from Oct 1 in parts of manipur, Nagaland and Arunachal Pradesh declared as 'disturbed areas' the current term of the law that gives special powers to armed forces in these areas is due to end on sept 30 .
